latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Test Effort Estimator skill.

- Provides systematic estimation of test effort based on product requirements.
- Breaks down features by complexity to estimate time for case design, first run, retest, and regression.
- Exports detailed effort estimates and rationale to Excel via provided script.
- Includes clear usage instructions and bundled references for standards and formulas.
- Ensures time values meet minimum and rounding constraints for accuracy.
